title: me
note: In 1.21.60, the message text supports input glyph replacement. For example, `:_input_key.jump:` is rendered as `JUMP` on keyboard or as a glyph on a gamepad.

fields.title: message
fields.description: A plain text or `string` that can include spaces and [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors)s.
